Feishu Slides Structured Markup Language (SML) 2.0
Version information: - Schema version: 2.0.0 - Namespace: https://www.larkoffice.com/sml/2.0 - Release date: 2025-11-03
Color format, supports solid colors and gradients

Supports two color formats: RGB/RGBA: - RGB: rgb(r,g,b) - Description: r,g,b are integers in [0,255] - Example: rgb(255,0,0) - RGBA: rgba(r,g,b,a) - Description: r,g,b are integers in [0,255], a is a float of 0 or 0.x ... 1 or 1.0 - Example: rgba(255,0,0,0.5) Note: Spaces are allowed, e.g. rgb(255, 0, 0) is also a valid format

The gradient color format supports the following types: - Linear gradient: Syntax: linear-gradient(angle, color stop, color stop, ...) Angle: [0,360) number + deg, e.g. 90deg, 180deg, indicating the gradient direction Color stop: defines the position of each color in the gradient (see "Color Stop Description") Example: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(255, 0, 0) 0%, rgb(0, 0, 255) 100%)
- Radial gradient: Syntax: radial-gradient(circle [at center position], color stop, color stop, ...) Shape: circle, only the circle shape is supported Center position: defines the position of the gradient center (see "Center Position Description") Color stop: defines the distribution of colors along the radial direction (see "Color Stop Description") Example: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgb(255, 0, 0) 0%, rgb(0, 0, 255) 100%)
- Rectangular gradient: Syntax: rect-gradient(circle [at center position], color stop, color stop, ...) Shape: circle, only the circle shape is supported Center position: defines the position of the gradient center (see "Center Position Description") Color stop: defines the distribution of colors within the rectangular range (see "Color Stop Description") Example: rect-gradient(circle at 0% 0%, rgb(255, 0, 0) 0%, rgb(0, 0, 255) 100%)
- Shape gradient: Syntax: shape-gradient(circle [at center position], color stop, color stop, ...) Shape: circle, only the circle shape is supported Center position: only 50% 50% is supported; if another position is entered, it will fall back to 50% 50% Color stop: defines the color distribution (see "Color Stop Description") Example: shape-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgb(255, 0, 0) 0%, rgb(0, 0, 255) 100%)
-------------------------------------------------------- Center Position Description: All non-linear gradients (radial gradient, rectangular gradient, shape gradient) can specify the gradient center position: - Format: x% y%, in percentage format (0-100% 0-100%), indicating the proportional position relative to the container width and height - The following enum values are supported: 0% 0%: top-left corner 100% 0%: top-right corner 50% 50%: center 0% 100%: bottom-left corner 100% 100%: bottom-right corner - If the position is out of the supported range or the format is incorrect, it will fall back to 50% 50%
Color Stop Description: - Format: color position% - Color: must be in rgb(r,g,b) or rgba(r,g,b,a) format - Without alpha channel: rgb(r,g,b), where r,g,b are integers in [0,255] - With alpha channel: rgba(r,g,b,a), where r,g,b are integers in [0,255], a is a float of 0 or 0.x ... 1 or 1.0 - Color stop: - Definition: the position of a color along the gradient path, at least 2 color stops are required - Position: integer percentage, value range [0, 100], followed by the % symbol

Font family name, any font is supported.

Font size, float, range [1, 4000], unit px Example: 10, 10.5, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 28, 32, etc.
Ordered list start number, value range [1, 32767]
List marker size, choose one of two: - Percentage string (relative to the text font size), value range 25%-400%, e.g. "100%" - Absolute pixel value, value range 6-400, e.g. "14"
Custom list marker, e.g. "★", "→", "✓", "◆", emoji is also supported
Text semantic level, affects the default font size and style title = large title headline = title sub-headline = subtitle body = body text caption = small body text
Dynamic text field types: - slidenum: current slide page number - datetime: default date-time format - datetime1-datetime13: predefined date-time formats
Date format dddd, MMMM D, YYYY, e.g. Friday, October 12, 2007
Date format D MMMM YYYY, e.g. 12 October 2007
Date format MMMM D, YYYY, e.g. October 12, 2007
Date format MMMM YY, e.g. October 07
Date-time format M/D/YYYY h:mm A, e.g. 10/12/2007 4:28 PM
Date-time format M/D/YYYY h:mm:ss A, e.g. 10/12/2007 4:28:34 PM
Time format h:mm A, e.g. 4:28 PM
Time format h:mm:ss A, e.g. 4:28:34 PM
Small, corresponds to ECMA-376 ST_LineEndLength / ST_LineEndWidth sm
Medium, corresponds to ECMA-376 ST_LineEndLength / ST_LineEndWidth med
Large, corresponds to ECMA-376 ST_LineEndLength / ST_LineEndWidth lg
Fill types: - color: color fill (RGB/RGBA format) - fillImg: image fill - fillPattern: pattern fill Priority: fillPattern > fillImg > color

Background pattern configuration Basic attributes: - type: pattern type, optional, default is pct5 - foregroundColor: foreground color (solid color), optional, defaults to following the font color - backgroundColor: background color (solid color), optional, default is white rgb(255, 255, 255) - alpha: opacity
Color fill configuration - color: solid colors and gradients - rotateWithShape: whether to rotate with the shape, only effective for gradients

Image fill configuration Basic attributes: - src: image resource identifier, required - alt: image alternative text/name, optional, default is empty - rotateWithShape: whether to rotate with the shape, optional, default is true - alpha: image opacity, optional, range [0, 1], default is 1
Stretch fill attributes: - stretchLeft/stretchRight: left/right stretch ratio, optional, range [-1000, 1000], (corresponds to -100000% to 100000%) - stretchTop/stretchBottom: top/bottom stretch ratio, optional, range [-1000, 1000], (corresponds to -100000% to 100000%)
Tile fill attributes: - flip: tile flip direction, optional - align: tile alignment, optional - horizontalOffset/verticalOffset: horizontal/vertical offset, optional - horizontalRatio/verticalRatio: horizontal/vertical scale ratio, optional, range [0, 1]
Note: Stretch and tile attributes cannot be used at the same time

General border style type - color: border color - width: border width (pixels) - dashArray: dash style - compound: compound border style - lineCap: line cap style - lineJoin: line join style - miterLimit: miter limit - rotateWithShape: whether to rotate with the shape Note: An empty border tag means no border by default; the default style follows different elements
Start arrow style type - type: start arrow type - widthScale: arrow width - heightScale: arrow height If type is none, it means no arrow, and other attributes are invalid
End arrow style type - type: end arrow type, optional, default arrow - widthScale: arrow width - heightScale: arrow height If type is none, it means no arrow, and other attributes are invalid

Crop position enum, used to specify which region of the original image to keep
- top: keep the top, crop the excess bottom part - bottom: keep the bottom, crop the excess top part - left: keep the left, crop the excess right part - right: keep the right, crop the excess left part - center: keep centered, crop evenly on all sides
For centered scenarios, anchor="center" can be set; when anchor is not set and offset is not set, it is also centered cropping by default
Keep the top, crop the excess bottom part
Keep the bottom, crop the excess top part
Keep the left, crop the excess right part
Keep the right, crop the excess left part
Keep centered, crop evenly on all sides

Crop configuration: crops the original image to the target size (the width × height of the img element)
Optional attributes: type: crop shape, default rect path: custom crop path, effective when type="custom", an SVG path string, with the coordinate system being the local coordinate system of the crop box anchor: crop anchor (top/bottom/left/right/center), see CropAnchorType leftOffset / rightOffset / topOffset / bottomOffset: offsets in the four directions (px), positive values crop inward, negative values expand outward to leave blank space, 0 aligns to the edge presetHandlers: control point configuration, corresponding to the control points of ECMA preset shapes. A single number or multiple numbers, separated by commas when multiple. Example: when type="rect" and presetHandlers="60", it is a rounded rectangle with a corner radius of 60px
[Recommended usage] Use anchor to specify the crop anchor: - When anchor is not set or anchor="center" is set: by default, crop centered on the image - When anchor is set: crop according to the specified anchor, for example anchor="top" means keep the top and crop off the excess at the bottom - After using anchor, there is no need to set offset - In anchor mode, the original image is scaled proportionally before cropping, so no stretching or compression occurs
[Advanced usage] Use offset to precisely control the crop boundaries: - Applicable to scenarios where the user manually adjusts the crop in the editor, or imports from an external protocol - The original image is first filled into the pre-crop area, then the final size is cropped from the four sides according to offset - Note: if the pre-crop size does not match the original image's aspect ratio, stretching distortion will occur; when the original image's aspect ratio cannot be determined, do not specify offset
[Priority] If both anchor and offset are set, anchor takes precedence and offset is ignored
Typical usage: centered crop (default behavior) centered crop (explicitly declared) keep top keep left rounded rectangle crop, centered by default

Reflection effect configuration - alpha: reflection opacity, value range [0,1] - offset: reflection offset, value range [0,200] (the spacing between the reflection and the original element, in pixels) - size: reflection size, value range [0,1] (ratio relative to the original element's height) - blur: reflection blur radius, value range [0,+∞) - startPos: start position, value range [0,1] - endAlpha: end opacity, value range [0,1] - direction: reflection direction angle, value range [0,360) - fadeDirection: fade-out direction angle, value range [0,360) - hScale: horizontal scale ratio, value range [-2,2] - vScale: vertical scale ratio, value range [-2,2] - hSkew: horizontal skew angle, value range [-90,90] - vSkew: vertical skew angle, value range [-90,90] - align: the alignment of the reflection relative to the element - rotWithShape: whether the reflection rotates with the shape Note: an empty tag indicates the default reflection effect (alpha=1, offset=8, size=0.3, blur=0, startPos=0, endAlpha=0, direction=90, fadeDirection=90, hScale=1, vScale=-1, hSkew=0, vSkew=0, align=bottom-left, rotWithShape=false)

Soft edge effect configuration - radius: soft edge radius (pixels), value range [0, +∞) Note: no softEdge tag indicates no soft edge effect, an empty softEdge tag indicates the default soft edge effect (radius=2)
Glow effect configuration - color: glow color - radius: glow radius (pixels), value range [0, +∞) Note: an empty tag indicates the default glow effect (color=rgba(0, 111, 171, 0.4), radius=5)

Outer shadow effect configuration Basic attributes: - color: shadow color - offset: shadow offset distance (pixels), value range [0, 200] (the distance of the shadow from the element, in pixels) - angle: shadow angle, value range [0, 360) (0 degrees is to the right, 90 degrees is downward, clockwise) - blur: blur radius (pixels), value range [0, 100], the larger the value, the more blurred Transform attributes (optional): - hScale: horizontal scale ratio, value range [-2, 2] (1 is the original size, less than 1 shrinks, greater than 1 enlarges) - vScale: vertical scale ratio, value range [-2, 2] (1 is the original size, less than 1 shrinks, greater than 1 enlarges) - hSkew: horizontal skew angle, value range [-90, 90] (negative values skew left, positive values skew right) - vSkew: vertical skew angle, value range [-90, 90] (negative values skew up, positive values skew down) Alignment: - shadowAlign: the alignment of the shadow relative to the element (default is top-left alignment) - rotWithShape: whether the shadow rotates with the shape Note: - An empty tag indicates the default shadow effect (color=rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), offset=15, blur=35, angle=45) - The three shadow effect types shadow, innerShadow, and presetShadow should be used as a choice of one among the three

Inner shadow effect configuration - color: shadow color - offset: shadow offset distance (pixels), value range [0, 200] - angle: shadow angle, value range [0, 360) (0 degrees is to the right, 90 degrees is downward, clockwise) - blur: blur radius (pixels), value range [0, 100] Note: - An empty tag indicates the default inner shadow effect (color=rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), offset=15, blur=35, angle=45) - The three shadow effect types shadow, innerShadow, and presetShadow should be used as a choice of one among the three

Preset shadow effect configuration - preset: OOXML preset shadow identifier, optional, default shdw1, values shdw1 to shdw20; missing or invalid values are treated as shdw1 - color: shadow color - offset: shadow offset distance (pixels), value range [0, 200] - angle: shadow angle, value range [0, 360) Note: - The three shadow effect types shadow, innerShadow, and presetShadow should be used as a choice of one among the three

Text outline configuration Attributes: - color: outline color - width: outline width - dashArray: dash style - compound: compound border style - lineCap: line cap style - lineJoin: line join style - miterLimit: miter limit
Theme type Child elements: - background: background fill, optional, default white rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) - textStyles: text style collection

Single slide structure Child elements: - style: page style (background color, etc.), the default fill color of style is white rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) - data: page element container (shape/line/polyline/img/table/icon/embed/chart/undefined) - note: speaker notes

Speaker notes, displayed only in presentation mode Supports the full content structure Attributes: - id: unique identifier of the note
Child elements: - content: note text content container

Presentation root type, containing the entire slide document structure - title: presentation title (optional) - theme: global theme settings (optional) - slide: slide pages (1-100 pages) Attributes: - id: unique identifier of the presentation (optional) - width: presentation width in pixels (required) - height: presentation height in pixels (required)

Text content root container, used to describe structured text Attribute description: - textType: controls the overall text style (title/headline/sub-headline/body/caption) - verticalAlign: the vertical alignment of the content within the container - paddingTop/Right/Bottom/Left: the spacing between the content and the container edges; when located in a shape and the shape's type is text, the default padding values are each 0; when the shape's type is other, the default padding values are each 5; when located in a td, the default padding values are each 8 - lineSpacing: Block-level line spacing - beforeLineSpacing/afterLineSpacing: line spacing before/after a paragraph, optional, default value fixed:0 - letterSpacing: content-level letter spacing - textAlign: content-level text alignment, optional; when located in a shape and the shape's type is text, the default textAlign value is left; when the shape's type is other, the default textAlign value is center - fontSize: content-level font size - fontFamily: content-level font family - color: content-level font color - backgroundColor: content-level background color - bold: whether the content level is bold - italic: whether the content level is italic - strikethrough: whether the content level has strikethrough - underline: whether the content level is underlined - list: content-level list type bullet/number - listStyle: content-level list style - bulletColor: list bullet color (solid color), optional - bulletSize: list bullet size, optional, a percentage string (relative to the text font size, value range 25%-400%) such as "100%", or an absolute pixel value (value range 6-400) such as "14" - autoStartAt: ordered list start number, optional, value range [1, 32767]; serves as the initial counter for descendant paragraphs, and child elements

/

    can reset it via their own autoStartAt - bulletChar: custom list bullet character, optional, such as "★", "→", etc.; once set, it overrides the bullet of listStyle - tabStopPos/defaultTabSize: the default Tab stop position and step for descendant paragraphs; the same-named attribute on p can override it - anchorCenter: controls text alignment, with higher priority than textAlign - autoFit: controls the handling strategy when text editing overflows - baseline: superscript/subscript, the offset relative to the text baseline - wrap: whether to wrap automatically Note: if a content child element does not specify an attribute, it inherits the attribute value of content by default; if a local child element specifies an attribute, the local attribute value is used autoStartAt running counter example (explicitly specified resets, unspecified continues the preceding counter):

    A

    B

    C

     Child elements: - p: paragraph element - ul: unordered list element - ol: ordered list element

Paragraph container, supports rich text content Can contain plain text and inline formatting elements (br/tab/strong/em/u/span/del/a/shadow/reflection/outline/glow/formula/field) Inline element nesting: all inline elements can contain plain text or other inline elements, to achieve complex formatting combinations Element self-nesting: except for the a/formula elements, the remaining inline elements support self-nesting; when shadow, reflection, outline, and glow are self-nested, the rendering effect follows the nearest principle, with the style defined by the inner layer taking precedence
Space handling rules: - Consecutive spaces within text are merged into a single space - Spaces at the beginning and end of text are ignored - When spaces need to be preserved (multiple consecutive, leading/trailing positions), use the character - Spaces and newline characters between tags are automatically omitted; for line breaks, use the
tag
Tab handling rules: - When a tab character is needed, use the tab element
Rich text element description: - br: line break - tab: tab character - strong: bold - em: italic - u: underline - span: text style - del: strikethrough - a: hyperlink - shadow: text shadow - reflection: text reflection - outline: text outline - glow: text glow - formula: scientific formula (supports mathematics, physics, etc.) - field: dynamic text field, the element content serves as the fallback text when dynamic fields are not supported Attribute description: - textAlign: text alignment - lineSpacing: line spacing - beforeLineSpacing/afterLineSpacing: line spacing before/after a paragraph - letterSpacing: letter spacing - level: paragraph level, value range [1,10] - list: list type (bullet/number) - listStyle: list style - bulletColor: list bullet color (solid color), optional - bulletSize: list bullet size, optional, a percentage string (relative to the text font size, value range 25%-400%) or an absolute pixel value (value range 6-400) - autoStartAt: ordered list start number, optional, value range [1, 32767]; when explicitly specified, resets the counter starting from the current paragraph; when not specified, continues the preceding counter within the same content - bulletChar: custom list bullet character, optional - marginLeft: left indent width of the paragraph - marginRight: right indent width of the paragraph - indent: first-line indent width - tabStopPos/defaultTabSize: paragraph-level Tab configuration, overriding the same-named configuration of content

Unordered list Attribute description: - listStyle: list style - bulletColor: list bullet color (solid color), optional - bulletSize: list bullet size, optional, percentage string (relative to text font size, value range 25%-400%) or absolute pixel value (value range 6-400) - bulletChar: custom list bullet character, optional, overrides the listStyle bullet when set

Ordered list, can specify the sequence number Attribute description: - listStyle: list style - bulletColor: list bullet color (solid color), optional - bulletSize: list bullet size, optional, percentage string (relative to text font size, value range 25%-400%) or absolute pixel value (value range 6-400) - autoStartAt: ordered list starting number, optional, value range [1, 32767]; acts as the initial counter value for this list group, child element <li@index> can override the individual item number

Undefined element, used to handle unsupported shape types; when unsupported type data is encountered during export, this element is used as a replacement Attribute description: - id: element unique identifier (optional) - type: the original unsupported type name, including video, audio, whiteboard

Shape element, supports multiple shapes and text content
Attribute description: - id: shape unique identifier (optional) - type: shape type (rect/ellipse/triangle etc., where text is a text box), required. - topLeftX/topLeftY: top-left corner coordinates, required - width/height: width and height dimensions, required - rotation: rotation angle [0, 360) - path: custom path (only valid when type=custom), optional - presetHandlers: shape control point settings (e.g., rounded corner settings), optional - flipX/flipY: horizontal/vertical flip, optional, default false - vert: text vertical alignment, optional - alpha: opacity [0,1], optional Child elements: - fill: fill style, optional, no fill tag means no fill, empty fill tag means default fill style (the default fill color for type="text" is transparent rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), the default fill color for other types is rgba(222, 224, 227, 1))) - border: border style, optional - no border tag: no border - empty border tag: default border - type="text": transparent border rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) - other type values: solid color takes S+10%, B-10%; gradient colors take S+10%, B-10% at each color stop; images/patterns have no border - content: text content within the shape, optional, rich text - reflection: reflection effect, optional, no reflection tag means no reflection effect, empty reflection tag means default reflection effect - shadow: outer shadow effect, optional, no shadow tag means no outer shadow effect, empty shadow tag means default outer shadow effect - innerShadow: inner shadow effect, optional, no innerShadow tag means no inner shadow effect, empty innerShadow tag means default inner shadow effect - presetShadow: preset shadow effect, optional - softEdge: soft edge effect, optional, no softEdge tag means no soft edge effect, empty softEdge tag means default soft edge effect (radius=2) - glow: glow effect, optional, no glow tag means no glow effect, empty glow tag means default glow effect (color=rgba(0, 111, 171, 0.4), radius=5)

Line/arrow element, supports multiple styles and arrow types
Attribute description: - type: line type - id: line unique identifier (optional) - startX/startY: start point coordinates - endX/endY: end point coordinates - alpha: opacity [0,1]
Coordinate description: - startX/startY and endX/endY are both absolute coordinates - start point = (startX, startY) - end point = (endX, endY)
Child elements: - border: line style (color/width/dash etc.), required, lines must have a border style, empty border tag means default style (color: rgba(43, 47, 54, 1)), width: 2px) - startArrow: start arrow, optional - endArrow: end arrow, optional - shadow: outer shadow effect, optional, no shadow tag means no outer shadow effect, empty shadow tag means default outer shadow effect - innerShadow: inner shadow effect, optional, no innerShadow tag means no inner shadow effect, empty innerShadow tag means default inner shadow effect - presetShadow: preset shadow effect, optional - reflection: reflection effect, optional, no reflection tag means no reflection effect, empty reflection tag means default reflection effect - softEdge: soft edge effect, optional, no softEdge tag means no soft edge effect, empty softEdge tag means default soft edge effect (radius=2) - glow: glow effect, optional, no glow tag means no glow effect, empty glow tag means default glow effect (color=rgba(0, 111, 171, 0.4), radius=5)

Polyline/curve element, supports multiple connection types and custom paths
Attribute description: - id: polyline unique identifier (optional) - type: line type, refer to the LineType enum - topLeftX/topLeftY: top-left corner coordinates of the bounding rectangle - width/height: width and height dimensions of the bounding rectangle - presetHandlers: controls the adjustment point positions of the polyline/curve - rotation: rotation angle [0,360) degrees) - flipX/flipY: horizontal/vertical flip - alpha: opacity [0,1]
Coordinate system description: - topLeftX/topLeftY define the position of the bounding rectangle - width/height define the size of the bounding rectangle
Child elements: - border: line style (color/width/dash etc.), required, lines must have a border style, empty border tag means default style (color: rgba(43, 47, 54, 1)), width: 2px) - startArrow: start arrow, optional - endArrow: end arrow, optional - shadow: outer shadow effect, optional, no shadow tag means no outer shadow effect, empty shadow tag means default outer shadow effect - innerShadow: inner shadow effect, optional, no innerShadow tag means no inner shadow effect, empty innerShadow tag means default inner shadow effect - presetShadow: preset shadow effect, optional - reflection: reflection effect, optional, no reflection tag means no reflection effect, empty reflection tag means default reflection effect - softEdge: soft edge effect, optional, no softEdge tag means no soft edge effect, empty softEdge tag means default soft edge effect (radius=2) - glow: glow effect, optional, no glow tag means no glow effect, empty glow tag means default glow effect (color=rgba(0, 111, 171, 0.4), radius=5)

Required attributes: src: image token topLeftX, topLeftY: top-left corner coordinates of the display position (after cropping) width, height: display dimensions (after cropping)
Optional attributes: id: unique identifier alt: description text rotation: rotation angle [0, 360) flipX, flipY: horizontal/vertical flip exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature: image adjustment parameters alpha: opacity [0, 1]
Optional child elements: crop: cropping. No tag / empty tag / only anchor set means crop to width×height after proportional scaling; anchor specifies the retained position (top/bottom/left/right/center), if anchor is not set it crops centered; offset is used for fine control reflection: reflection. No tag means no reflection, empty tag means use default style shadow: outer shadow. No tag means no outer shadow, empty tag means use default style innerShadow: inner shadow. No tag means no inner shadow, empty tag means use default style presetShadow: preset shadow. No tag means no preset shadow, empty presetShadow tag means default preset shadow softEdge: soft edge. No softEdge tag means no soft edge, empty softEdge tag means default soft edge (radius=2) glow: glow. No glow tag means no glow, empty glow tag means default glow (color=rgba(0, 111, 171, 0.4), radius=5) border: border. No tag means no border, empty tag means use default style (color: rgba(43, 47, 54, 1), width: 2) fill: fill. No tag means no fill, empty tag means use default style (color: rgba(91, 155, 213, 1))

Icon element, supports external icon resources and style configuration Attributes: - id: icon unique identifier (optional) - iconType: icon type, from the iconpark icon library - width/height: display dimensions - rotation: rotation angle - topLeftX/topLeftY: top-left corner coordinates - flipX/flipY: horizontal/vertical flip - alpha: opacity [0,1]
Child elements: - fill: fill style, no fill tag means no fill, empty fill tag means use default style (default color fill, color is rgba(208, 211, 214, 1)) - border: border style, no border tag means no border, empty border tag means use default style (default solid border, color is rgba(51, 51, 51, 1), width is 3) - reflection: reflection style, no reflection tag means no reflection, empty reflection tag means use default style - shadow: outer shadow style, no shadow tag means no outer shadow, empty shadow tag means use default style - innerShadow: inner shadow style, no innerShadow tag means no inner shadow, empty innerShadow tag means use default style - presetShadow: preset shadow style, no presetShadow tag means no preset shadow, empty presetShadow tag means default preset shadow - softEdge: soft edge style, no softEdge tag means no soft edge, empty softEdge tag means default soft edge (radius=2) - glow: glow style, no glow tag means no glow, empty glow tag means default glow (color=rgba(0, 111, 171, 0.4), radius=5)

Embedded content container, the outer layer carries Slides placement and effect attributes, the inner layer carries external standard content. Currently the inner content is standard SVG, and the http://www.w3.org/2000/svg namespace must be used. It can be extended later to carry other external content such as HTML.
Required attributes: - topLeftX/topLeftY: top-left corner coordinates - width/height: display dimensions
Optional attributes: - id: unique identifier - rotation: rotation angle [0, 360) - flipX/flipY: horizontal/vertical flip - alpha: opacity [0,1]
Child elements: - svg: standard SVG root element, only describes the embedded content, does not carry Slides layout attributes - reflection: reflection style, no reflection tag means no reflection, empty reflection tag means use default style - shadow: outer shadow style, no shadow tag means no outer shadow, empty shadow tag means use default style - innerShadow: inner shadow style, no innerShadow tag means no inner shadow, empty innerShadow tag means use default style - presetShadow: preset shadow style, no presetShadow tag means no preset shadow, empty presetShadow tag means default preset shadow - softEdge: soft edge style, no softEdge tag means no soft edge, empty softEdge tag means default soft edge (radius=2) - glow: glow style, no glow tag means no glow, empty glow tag means default glow (color=rgba(0, 111, 171, 0.4), radius=5)

Table element, used to display structured data The width/height allocation rules refer to the overall value / child value handling logic of HTML table, but deterministic constraints are applied in SXSD to ensure consistent cross-platform implementation. Border rules: - Later setting takes precedence: adjacent cell lines have only one color; if both are set, the setting of the bottom-right cell overrides the top-left cell - When the border attribute is not set, the default style is used
Fill rules: - Cells can have independent fill styles - When the fill attribute is not set, the table default style is used
table attributes: - id: table unique identifier (optional) - topLeftX/topLeftY: top-left corner coordinates - flipX/flipY: horizontal/vertical flip - width: table target total width (optional). If set, it is preferentially used to allocate remaining width to columns without a specified column width; when all column widths are empty, all columns equally divide this value; when all columns are specified and this value is greater than the sum of specified column widths, the extra space continues to be allocated to existing columns, by default using each column's current width as the weight for allocation; when the sum of specified column widths exceeds or cannot accommodate this value, the specified column widths are retained, and the final sum of column widths is written back to table.width - height: table target total height (optional). If set, it is preferentially used to allocate remaining height to rows without a specified row height; when all row heights are empty, all rows equally divide this value; when all rows are specified and this value is greater than the sum of specified row heights, the extra space continues to be allocated to existing rows, by default using each row's current height as the weight for allocation; when the sum of specified row heights exceeds or cannot accommodate this value, the specified row heights are retained, and the final sum of row heights is written back to table.height table child elements: - colgroup: column group element, used to define column widths - tr: row element, contains multiple cells
colgroup child elements: - col: column element col attributes: - span: column span, default is 1, optional - width: column width input value, default value is 110, optional. When there is no table.width, specified columns keep their original values, and empty columns use the default value; when there is table.width, specified columns keep their original values, and empty columns preferentially equally divide the remaining width; if there are no empty columns and table.width is greater than the sum of specified column widths, the extra space is allocated to all columns using each column's current width as the weight; if the remaining width is insufficient, empty columns fall back to the default value, and the final sum of column widths is used as table.width
tr attributes: - height: row height input value, default value is 37, optional. When there is no table.height, specified rows keep their original values, and empty rows use the default value; when there is table.height, specified rows keep their original values, and empty rows preferentially equally divide the remaining height; if there are no empty rows and table.height is greater than the sum of specified row heights, the extra space is allocated to all rows using each row's current height as the weight; if the remaining height is insufficient, empty rows fall back to the default value, and the final sum of row heights is used as table.height. If the row height is lower than the content height, the row height needs to be manually modified tr child elements: - td: cell element, used to display data
td attributes: - id: cell unique identifier (optional) - colspan: cell column span, default is 1 - rowspan: cell row span, default is 1 td child elements: - borderTop/borderRight/borderBottom/borderLeft: cell border style, no border tag means no border, empty border tag means use default style (solid border, color is rgba(221, 222, 223, 1), width is 1) - fill: cell fill style, no fill tag means no fill, empty fill tag means use default style (default color fill, color is rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)) - content: cell content. Content by default does not modify the table geometry in reverse; when the content height is greater than the current row height, the row height needs to be manually modified

Formula content in LaTeX format. The LaTeX string contained in this element must strictly conform to the macro set range defined in the attachment.
Content syntax: - Syntax scope: only use macros explicitly supported in the attachment whitelist. - Expression recommendations: prefer standard math environments such as basic operators, fractions (\frac), radicals (\sqrt), matrices (matrix), etc. - Format requirements: content must be wrapped in CDATA, and XML escaping (such as <, &) is strictly prohibited inside CDATA. - Whitespace handling: the parser will preserve all line breaks and indentation inside CDATA; it is recommended to use this feature to keep the LaTeX source structured and readable.

Tab stop list, used for content@tabStopPos or p@tabStopPos; p takes higher priority. Format is position+alignment, comma-separated, e.g. "100r,200l,300ctr"; alignment supports l/ctr/r/dec. Position unit is px, finite positive number, decimals supported, range (0,4031]; list length 1-32. When a tab element is encountered, use the first stop position greater than the current inline coordinate; if none exists, step by defaultTabSize.
